attempts.exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one proposed static full-body Wight master for a Heroes III Necropolis creature asset review. Generate a newly rendered image, not an enlargement of the source pixels.
Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL Wight native idle sprite, enlarged by nearest neighbor only for inspection: use it as the authority for creature identity, brown costume, body proportions, silhouette, idle pose and right-facing view. Input image 2 is the approved Pikeman rendering master: use it ONLY for fine modeled-volume shading, subtle texture, concentrated highlights and crisp readable materials. Do not copy that soldier's body, pose, helmet, armor, weapon, heraldry or colors.
Subject: faithfully render the Wight in image 1 as a tall very slender hooded undead specter, in the same quiet upright idle pose, head and body facing screen RIGHT in the same slight three-quarter side view. Deep, muted dark earth-brown rough cloth hood and loose robe, worn but restrained brown folds; small pale grey-ivory skeletal face recessed in the hood with dark eye sockets and the long narrow pale lower-face/throat detail visible in the source. Thin pale bony hands, empty and held close to the torso: the near forearm crosses loosely across the upper belly, the far hand is slightly higher near the chest. Long hanging sleeves. The cloth body tapers down to a narrow irregular ragged trailing hem; no visible feet or footwear. Preserve the source's slight forward curve and compact shoulder width. Whole hood, both hands, sleeve tips and lowest cloth point fully visible.
Silhouette/proportion lock: native visible bounds are 29 pixels wide by 88 pixels tall, so aim for the same narrow width-to-height ratio, approximately 0.33, without spreading the arms or billowing the cloak sideways. No heroic broad shoulders, no inflated robe, no chibi head. Match the native hood angle, face direction, hand placement, robe weight and asymmetry instead of creating a generic reaper.
Rendering: the same refined classic pre-rendered game-sprite finish as input image 2: fine sculptural volume, small controlled highlights, subtle cloth grain, bone texture, deep restrained shadow planes, crisp fine edges. Readable at small game size. Smooth finely modeled shading, not block-pixel art, not cartoon cel shading, not a flat silhouette. Keep the original warm dark brown cloth and dull pale bone palette; highlights remain concentrated on existing material forms.
Composition/output: ONE character only on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Portrait framing with generous empty alpha margins around every extremity, no cropping. No labels, no text, no watermark, no background, no floor, no cast shadow, no pedestal.
Strict exclusions: no scythe, staff, sword, shield or any other weapon; no armor, jewelry, belt buckle or added costume symbols; no blue/white Castle colors; no glowing eyes in this idle pose; no smoke, aura, magic, slash arc, particles or invented effects. All silhouette detail must belong to this brown-robed Wight. This is one idle master proposal, not an animation sheet.
